diffs.diff: chip ID register 0xfa: part 17, datasheet reading 47633
diffs.evidence: The Pimoroni driver defines 'CHIP_ID = 0xBA11' and reads it little-endian as two bytes starting at 'REG_CHIP_ID_L = 0xFA', so the byte register 0xFA holds the low byte 0x11 = 17 (as the model has) while 47633 = 0xBA11 is the same ID read as a 16-bit word.
